record.summary: What multiplies and what does not. At N=1 nothing changes. At N=3 every replica is identical: a StatefulSet pod running the supervisor, with its own volume, two Raft clusters per replica (rauthy's and the app's), peers discovered by stable pod DNS, one key set injected as a Secret and custodied once, the public origin on an Ingress that terminates TLS and keeps /metrics off it, a CronJob that runs backup --to s3:// against the leader, and a ServiceMonitor example. Rate limiting is per node and says so. A shared volume between Raft members is refused by the manifests themselves. Carries enrahitu://030.
record.title: Cluster topology: N=1 primary, N=3 StatefulSet on Kubernetes, one key set, S3 backups
